faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gym Trainer position at KUDSIT Digital University of Kerala?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Gym Trainer position is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a certified personal trainer from a recognized institution in India and possess at least one year of experience as a fitness trainer in the gym of a reputed educational institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Gym Trainer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Gym Trainer position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Gym Trainer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be offered a salary of Rs. 900 per day. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Gym Trainer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Gym Trainer role will involve an interview and a test. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Gym Trainer job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official KUDSIT Digital University of Kerala website. The application link will be available in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Gym Trainer (on daily wages) as per the official notification released by KUDSIT Digital University of Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Gym Trainer position is a contractual role. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.
